title: DesktopEngine mini program manifest (manifest.json)
description: At the root of the mini program package, next to the entry index.js. See https://desktopengine.github.io/desktopengine-sdk/reference/manifest

id.description: A unique identifier in reverse domain name form, e.g. com.example.clock

name.description: The name shown in the library

type.description: The kind of content: wallpaper, widget or pet (desktop pet)

version.description: The version, semantic versioning is recommended, e.g. 1.0.0

apiVersion.description: The lowest runtime API version it needs (DesktopEngine.apiVersion); older versions of the app refuse to import it

author.description: The name of the author or developer

description.description: A sentence or two about it, shown in the details pane

icon.description: A square icon, a path in the package

preview.description: The preview image in the library grid, a path in the package

sizes.description: The sizes it supports, as in WidgetKit: small 164×164, medium 344×164, large 344×344

permissions.description: The permissions it needs, which the app lists in the details pane and asks for the first time it runs

parameters.description: Options users can change. The app draws them as a form in the details pane and passes their values in DesktopEngine.launchOptions.parameters

localizedString.description: Text shown to users: a string, or translations by language, e.g. { "en": "Clock", "zh-Hans": "时钟" }. The app picks the user's preferred language, and en when none matches
